insertion-sorts the 16-byte elements in [`rcx`, `rdx`) with the function pointer `f` at qword `[r8]`: for each element after the first it copies the element to a stack copy `t`; when `f(&t, first)` returns non-zero `al` it moves [first, element) up by 16 bytes with `memmove` (IAT slot `008C2A40`) and stores `t` at the first element; otherwise it moves each preceding element up one place while `f(&t, preceding)` returns non-zero and stores `t` into the place left free; an empty range writes nothing

with base `rcx`, `n` = (`rdx` - `rcx`) / 16 and the function pointer `f` at qword `[r8]`, does nothing when `n` is less than 2 (signed); otherwise for each `i` from `n`/2 - 1 down to 0 it copies element `i` to a stack value `v` and, with hole `h` = `i`, while `h` is less than `q` (signed) = (`n` - 1) / 2 takes child `c` = 2`h` + 2 (or `c` - 1 when `f(base + 16c, base + 16(c-1))` returns non-zero `al`), copies element `c` into element `h` and sets `h` = `c`; when `h` then equals `q` and bit `0x1` of `n` is clear it copies element `n` - 1 into `h` and sets `h` = `n` - 1; then while `h` is greater than `i` (signed) and `f(base + 16p, &v)` returns non-zero for `p` = (`h` - 1) / 2 it copies element `p` into `h` and sets `h` = `p`, and finally stores `v` into element `h`

orders the three 16-byte elements `a` = `rcx`, `b` = `rdx`, `c` = `r8` with the function pointer `f` at qword `[r9]`: swaps `a` and `b` when `f(b, a)` returns non-zero `al`; then, when `f(c, b)` does, swaps `b` and `c` and again swaps `a` and `b` when `f(b, a)` does

with base `rcx`, hole `h` = `rdx` (also the top), count `n` = `r8`, value at `r9` and the function pointer `f` at qword `[fifth argument]`: while `h` is less than `q` (signed) = (`n` - 1) / 2 it takes child `c` = 2`h` + 2, uses `c` - 1 instead when `f(base + 16c, base + 16(c-1))` returns non-zero `al`, copies element `c` into element `h` and sets `h` = `c`; when `h` then equals `q` and bit `0x1` of `n` is clear it copies element `n` - 1 into element `h` and sets `h` = `n` - 1; finally tail-jumps to `006B7F00(base, h, top, r9, fifth argument)`

with base `rcx`, hole index `h` = `rdx`, top index `r8`, value at `r9` and the function pointer `f` at qword `[fifth argument]`: while `h` is greater than `r8` (signed) and `f(base + 16*p, r9)` returns non-zero `al` for `p` = (`h` - 1) / 2, copies element `p` into element `h` and sets `h` = `p`; then copies the 16 bytes at `r9` into element `h`

for the 16-byte elements in [`rcx`, `rdx`), while at least two remain, takes the last element `l` into a stack copy `t`, copies the first element over `l` and calls `006B7E00(rcx, 0, (l - rcx) / 16, &t, r8)`, then drops `l` from the range

when `rcx` is non-null, for each of the `edx` 16-byte entries at `rcx` calls `00584730(qword [e+8])` when bit `0x80000000` of dword `[e]` is clear and that qword is non-null, stores 0 to both, then calls `00584730(rcx)`; a null `rcx` writes nothing
